title: COA flags P397M ‘duplicate,’ ‘overlapping’ AICS payments

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Commission on Audit (COA) said it found P397.45 million worth of “duplicate, multiple and overlapping” payments to beneficiaries of the Assistance to Individuals in Crisis Situation (AICS) program implemented by the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD). In its 2025 annual audit report, COA noted that some beneficiaries of the AICS program were granted “duplicate” or “multiple” types of assistance, which violated the allowable frequency of payments established under a 2022 DSWD memorandum circular. Meanwhile, other beneficiaries were able to avail of similar benefits under both the AICS and Ayuda sa Kapos ang Kita Program (Akap) of the […]...
